description: Measures the ACTUAL running batch via vllm:num_requests_running, to test whether session 18's n=128/256 columns ever ran the batch they were labelled with (review 4.1).
note_prediction: REGISTERED. If the gauge peaks well below n at 128/256, session 18's refutation of the bandwidth account is unsupported and must be withdrawn.
prediction_mechanism: Target: effective running batch. Lever: requested concurrency n. The gauge reads the scheduler's own running set, so d(running)/d(n) is nonzero up to whatever cap max_num_seqs or KV capacity imposes — and locating that cap is the point.
